speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap
text: asked the Minister for Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (a) who is involved in the selection and appointment of the members of the recently announced Committee on Future Asatizah (COFA); and (b) what are the criteria used in the selection and appointment of these members to COFA.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
text: Since its establishment, COFA has been engaging key stakeholders and the wider community extensively.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
text: Members of the public can also give their feedback and suggestions through an online portal.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence and Foreign Affairs (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources and Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs)
text: Through the COFA engagements, the wider community will be able to share their aspirations for our future asatizahs and how they can better meet the evolving socio-religious needs of the community.
